mapper.select: SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID() AS id
SELECT DATABASE() AS name
SELECT GET_LOCK(#{name},20) AS locked
SELECT stu_id AS id,stu_name AS name,stu_pwd AS password,stu_class,stu_phone FROM student WHERE stu_id=#{id}
SELECT tea_id AS id,tea_name AS name,tea_pwd AS password FROM teacher WHERE tea_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET stu_pwd=#{password} WHERE stu_id=#{id}
UPDATE teacher SET tea_pwd=#{password} WHERE tea_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*,c.club_name FROM club_member m JOIN club c ON c.club_id=m.club_id WHERE m.stu_id=#{stuId} AND m.leave_time IS NULL
SELECT * FROM v_club_info ORDER BY club_create_time DESC,club_id DESC
SELECT * FROM v_club_info WHERE club_id=#{clubId}
SELECT club_id FROM club WHERE club_name=#{name}
SELECT * FROM v_club_info WHERE tea_id=#{teaId}
SELECT tea_id,tea_name FROM teacher t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club c WHERE c.tea_id=t.tea_id) ORDER BY tea_id

SELECT a.apply_id,a.club_id,c.club_name,a.apply_time,a.apply_status,a.reply_time FROM join_apply a JOIN club c ON c.club_id=a.club_id WHERE a.stu_id=#{stuId} ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC,a.apply_id DESC
SELECT member_id,club_name,member_role,join_time,leave_time,leave_type FROM v_stu_club_record WHERE stu_id=#{stuId} ORDER BY join_time DESC,member_id DESC

SELECT l.*,c.club_name,s.stu_name AS operate_name FROM club_member_change_log l JOIN club c ON c.club_id=l.club_id JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=l.operate_stu_id WHERE l.stu_id=#{stuId} ORDER BY l.log_id DESC
SELECT * FROM v_stu_club_record WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND leave_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY leave_time DESC
SELECT * FROM club_member WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND stu_id=#{stuId} AND leave_time IS NULL
SELECT member_id,stu_id,stu_name,stu_class,stu_phone,member_role,join_time FROM v_club_member_detail WHERE club_id=#{clubId} ORDER BY member_id
mapper.update: UPDATE v_stu_club_record SET leave_time=NOW(),leave_type='quit',operate_stu_id=#{stuId} WHERE stu_id=#{stuId} AND leave_time IS NULL
UPDATE club_member SET leave_time=NOW(),leave_type='kick',operate_stu_id=#{operator} WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND stu_id=#{stuId} AND leave_time IS NULL AND member_role<>'president'
mapper.select: SELECT leave_time FROM club_member WHERE member_id=#{id}
SELECT apply_id,stu_id,stu_name,stu_class,stu_phone,apply_time FROM v_join_apply_pending WHERE club_id=#{clubId} ORDER BY apply_time,apply_id
SELECT * FROM join_apply WHERE apply_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE join_apply SET apply_status=#{result},approve_stu_id=#{operator},reply_time=NOW() WHERE apply_id=#{id} AND apply_status='pending'
mapper.select: {CALL sp_submit_join_apply(#{clubId},#{stuId})}
{CALL sp_change_member_role(#{clubId},#{stuId},#{role},#{operator})}
{CALL sp_submit_dissolve_apply(#{clubId},#{stuId})}
{CALL sp_create_club(#{id})}
{CALL sp_dissolve_club(#{id})}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(log_id),0) AS id FROM club_member_change_log WHERE club_id=#{clubId}
mapper.update: UPDATE club_member_change_log SET operate_stu_id=#{operator} WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND log_id>#{afterId}
UPDATE club_member_change_log SET old_role=#{role} WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND stu_id=#{stuId} AND new_role='president' AND log_id>#{afterId}
mapper.select: SELECT act_id,act_name,act_desc,act_start_time,act_end_time,act_place,act_status FROM club_activity WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND act_status IN ('running','finish') ORDER BY act_start_time DESC,act_id DESC

SELECT a.act_id,a.act_name,a.act_desc,a.act_start_time,a.act_end_time,a.act_place,a.act_status,a.apply_time,t.tea_name AS audit_tea_name,a.audit_time FROM club_activity a LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.tea_id=a.audit_tea_id WHERE a.club_id=#{clubId} ORDER BY a.act_start_time DESC,a.act_id DESC
SELECT a.*,c.tea_id FROM club_activity a JOIN club c ON c.club_id=a.club_id WHERE a.act_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE club_activity SET act_status='finish' WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND act_id=#{id} AND act_status='running'
mapper.select: SELECT a.*,c.club_name FROM club_activity a JOIN club c ON c.club_id=a.club_id WHERE c.tea_id=#{teaId} AND a.act_status='wait_audit' ORDER BY a.apply_time,a.act_id
mapper.update: UPDATE club_activity SET act_status=#{status},audit_tea_id=#{teaId},audit_time=NOW() WHERE act_id=#{id} AND act_status='wait_audit'
mapper.select: SELECT n.*,s.stu_name AS publish_name FROM club_notice n JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=n.publish_stu_id WHERE n.club_id=#{clubId} AND n.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC,n.notice_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE club_notice SET notice_title=#{title},notice_content=#{content} WHERE notice_id=#{id} AND club_id=#{clubId} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE club_notice SET is_deleted=1 WHERE notice_id=#{id} AND club_id=#{clubId} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.msg_id,m.publish_stu_id,s.stu_name AS publish_name,m.msg_title,m.msg_content,m.publish_time FROM system_message m JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=m.publish_stu_id WHERE m.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY m.publish_time DESC,m.msg_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE system_message SET msg_title=#{title},msg_content=#{content} WHERE msg_id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE system_message SET is_deleted=1 WHERE msg_id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student_union_member WHERE stu_id=#{stuId}
SELECT u.stu_id,s.stu_name,u.join_time FROM student_union_member u JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=u.stu_id ORDER BY u.id
SELECT l.*,s.stu_name,t.stu_name AS operate_name FROM student_union_operate_log l JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=l.stu_id JOIN student t ON t.stu_id=l.operate_stu_id ORDER BY l.log_id DESC
SELECT * FROM club_create_apply WHERE create_apply_id=#{id}
SELECT m.stu_id,s.stu_name FROM club_create_apply_member m JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=m.stu_id WHERE m.create_apply_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.id

SELECT a.*,t.tea_name AS apply_tea_name,s.stu_name AS union_audit_name,t.tea_name AS tea_audit_name FROM club_create_apply a JOIN teacher t ON t.tea_id=a.apply_tea_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.stu_id=a.union_audit_stu_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.union_audit_status='pending' AND a.final_status='pending' AND a.apply_tea_id=#{userId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM club_create_apply_member m WHERE m.create_apply_id=a.create_apply_id AND m.stu_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC,a.create_apply_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE club_create_apply SET union_audit_status=#{result},union_audit_stu_id=#{operator},union_audit_time=NOW(),final_status=#{finalStatus} WHERE create_apply_id=#{id} AND union_audit_status='pending' AND final_status='pending'
UPDATE club_create_apply SET tea_audit_status=#{result},tea_audit_time=NOW(),final_status=#{finalStatus} WHERE create_apply_id=#{id} AND tea_audit_status='pending' AND final_status='pending'

UPDATE club_create_apply SET union_audit_status=#{unionAuditStatus},union_audit_stu_id=#{unionAuditStuId},union_audit_time=#{unionAuditTime},tea_audit_status=#{teaAuditStatus},tea_audit_time=#{teaAuditTime},final_status=#{finalStatus} WHERE create_apply_id=#{createApplyId} AND final_status='pending'
mapper.select: SELECT a.*,c.tea_id FROM club_dissolve_apply a JOIN club c ON c.club_id=a.club_id WHERE a.dissolve_apply_id=#{id}
SELECT dissolve_apply_id FROM club_dissolve_apply WHERE club_id=#{clubId} AND final_status='pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE club_dissolve_apply SET union_audit_status=#{result},union_audit_stu_id=#{operator},union_audit_time=NOW(),final_status=#{finalStatus} WHERE dissolve_apply_id=#{id} AND union_audit_status='pending' AND final_status='pending'
UPDATE club_dissolve_apply SET tea_audit_status=#{result},tea_audit_time=NOW(),final_status=#{finalStatus} WHERE dissolve_apply_id=#{id} AND tea_audit_status='pending' AND final_status='pending'
UPDATE club_dissolve_apply SET final_status='success' WHERE dissolve_apply_id=#{id} AND final_status='pending' AND union_audit_status='agree' AND tea_audit_status='agree'

UPDATE club_dissolve_apply SET union_audit_status=#{unionAuditStatus},union_audit_stu_id=#{unionAuditStuId},union_audit_time=#{unionAuditTime},tea_audit_status=#{teaAuditStatus},tea_audit_time=#{teaAuditTime},final_status=#{finalStatus} WHERE dissolve_apply_id=#{dissolveApplyId}
